SELECT
FONT_ID AS fontid,
FONT_FAMILY AS fontfamily,
FONT_FULL_NAME AS fontfullname,
FONT_FILE_NAME AS fontfilename,
FONT_FILE_PATH AS fontfilepath,
FONT_WEIGHT AS fontweight,
FONT_STYLE AS fontstyle,
USE_YN AS useyn,
REG_DT AS regdt
FROM TB_FONT
WHERE FONT_FAMILY = #{fontfamily}
AND USE_YN = 'Y'
